mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to equity risk premiums, leading to consistently positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of trading days when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.13%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of trading days when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) are high and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low, the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of instances when RSAFS is above 390000 and FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it signals a weak labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve is likely to implement accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of trading days when UNRATE is above 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 97.0, it signals strong economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of trading days when INDPRO is above 97.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly real GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 13500.0 billion dollars, it signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of trading days when GDPC1 is above 13500.0.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of residential sales (RSAFS) is positively correlated with consumer spending and equity valuations, leading to consistently positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of trading days when RSAFS is at its current value (394524.0).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 230.0, it signals elevated inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Federal Reserve may tighten policy.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 65% of trading days when CPIAUCSL is above 230.0.
